title: Canonical career spine — Adrian Wedd
purpose: The smallest machine-readable export of verified career facts. This repo (adrianwedd/cv) owns canonical facts: employment dates, roles, durable achievements, technologies actually used, project facts, stable metrics. Downstream consumers (adrianwedd/job-search) snapshot this file explicitly, record the source commit, and must not contradict it silently. Role-specific prose may EXTEND these claims only with its own evidence; it never rewrites them.

statuses.verified: Documented evidence exists (employment records, repo history, published data, or explicit confirmation by Adrian recorded in a QA trail).
statuses.qualified: True with the stated bounds; do not restate more broadly than the claim text.
statuses.retired: Previously asserted somewhere; evidence does not support it. Do not reuse. Revert only with new documentary evidence.
statuses.unresolved: Contradictory or unconfirmed; do not assert in outward-facing material until resolved.

evidence_hierarchy.purpose: When sources conflict, higher rank wins. A QA'd application is a rigorously audited INTERPRETATION, not primary evidence — it must never become evidence for itself or outrank the records it was derived from.
ranks: 1. primary source: artifact, repository, employment or business record, published data
2. explicitly user-confirmed fact (recorded in a QA trail, e.g. 'PER ADRIAN')
4. QA'd application interpretation (job-search packages, however many engines signed off)
evidence_hierarchy.rule: An evidence ref citing only rank-4 material supports at most QUALIFIED status; VERIFIED requires rank 1 or 2 somewhere in the chain. Rank-5 sources are leads, never evidence.
